source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Derived parish summaries ship under the BSS Open Licence Agreement (free reuse with the acknowledgement-of-source notice). Raw census PDFs are not committed.
source_datasets.notes: Integer full-count; 23-category frame; Both Sexes rows. Both margins close exactly: every parish column and every religion row sum to the printed national total of 226,193. No cell suppression. Printed '-' transcribed as 0. The denominator is the Tabulable Population (226,193); the Estimated Resident Population (277,821) is a separate adjusted figure and is not the religion denominator.

source_datasets.notes: 11 ADM1 parishes, boundaryYearRepresented 2005, joined one-to-one to the census parishes via a St.->Saint name crosswalk. The extent spans lon -59.65 to -59.42E and lat 13.04 to 13.34N, far from the antimeridian; no dateline handling is needed.

indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Parish all-persons Tabulable Population represented in the 2010 religion table.
indicators.method: Printed parish Total from 2010 Census Volume 1 Table 02.06 (Both Sexes).
indicators.quality_notes: Religion is asked of the whole resident population (no age restriction). The denominator is the Tabulable Population (national 226,193), distinct from the Estimated Resident Population (277,821); the difference is the census undercount and is not part of the religion denominator.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the parish population reporting affiliation with a named religion or denomination.
indicators.quality_notes: Single wave (2010): religion is cross-tabulated by parish only in the 2010 census; 1990 and 2000 religion are published nationally only (2000 Report Table 2.7), and 2021 collected religion (questionnaire P11) but published no religion table. Percentages use each parish's Tabulable Population Total. The Not Stated line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the parish population in the census None line.
indicators.method: 100 * None / population. The Not Stated line is not part of this slot.
indicators.quality_notes: The national no-religion share was 20.6% in 2010 (46,559 / 226,193); the construct is the share reporting None, read within each parish's own denominator. Percentages use each parish's Tabulable Population Total. The Not Stated line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.
